jobs.title: Director
jobs.reason: This is a "Director" role providing executive leadership over a senior team of three Deputy Directors and holding ultimate executive responsibility — a senior/executive title far beyond entry-level. The candidate has no full-time or leadership experience, so the level is a hard mismatch despite the human-rights and international-law relevance.

jobs.title: Call for Applicants: Advisory Committee — Project on Criminalisation of Environmental Human Rights Defenders
jobs.reason: This is a call for expert advisory committee members, not a paid staff role — it seeks established experts (activists and specialists from the named regions) rather than an early-career analyst, and is effectively an unpaid advisory/volunteer position. Although the human-rights and securitisation theme aligns with the candidate's interests, the role is not a genuine paid entry-level vacancy and the candidate lacks the senior expert profile sought.

jobs.title: Strategic Litigation Team Manager
jobs.reason: The "Manager" title and Reprieve's own pay-band placement (Project/Regional Leads/Managers) make this a management-level role well beyond entry-level, and strategic litigation strongly implies a legal qualification the candidate lacks. The human-rights mission is a perfect interest match, but the level and likely qualification are hard mismatches.

jobs.title: Fundraising Coordinator
jobs.reason: This is an entry-level coordinator role at an on-mission human-rights organisation, but it is a fundraising / development function that sits outside the candidate's research and policy strengths and does not match their limited dedicated fundraising or campaigns experience. The organisation is a strong interest fit, but the functional mismatch keeps this marginal.
jobs.salary: £32,696 per annum plus up to 5% matched pension

jobs.title: Advisory Committee Member — Project on Criminalisation of Environmental Human Rights Defenders
jobs.reason: This is a call for established "experts" to sit on an advisory committee, not a paid entry-level role — it is a speculative advisory/volunteer position seeking senior subject-matter authorities the candidate is not yet. The human-rights and securitisation subject matter is interesting, but the seniority and non-employment nature are disqualifying.

jobs.title: Associate or Senior Editor, Communications Physics
jobs.reason: Requires an already-completed PhD in a physics discipline covered by the journal, which the candidate does not hold and which is entirely outside their field. This is a hard qualification and subject-matter mismatch on every axis.

jobs.title: Associate or Senior Editor, BMC Primary Care and BMC Ophthalmology
jobs.reason: Requires a PhD or MD (or equivalent) in a relevant field as an essential, which the candidate does not hold. The role is also in medical/scientific publishing (primary care, ophthalmology), far outside the candidate's background and interests.

jobs.title: Fleming Initiative Policy Fellow
jobs.reason: The role explicitly seeks "an experienced policy professional," and the salary band (£57k–£69k) signals a senior, several-years-experienced fellowship well beyond the candidate's student-assistant/RA background — an unmet essential experience level. The subject (antimicrobial resistance / health policy) also sits outside the core interest zones.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive - Life Sciences
jobs.reason: Requires 8+ years of enterprise sales experience (at least 5 in life-sciences tech sales), far beyond entry-level and a hard disqualifier on both level and experience. It is also an enterprise sales role with no research or policy component, entirely outside the candidate's profile and interests.
